claim: The approach transforms the catalogue without hiding uncertainty.
Separating missing, non-applicable, excluded, and pending values was essential to avoid false errors and complete the model without inventing data.
Compound identifiers remove collisions, and regression tests reduce the risk of recurrence.
The candidate version may proceed to pre-production once municipal confirmations are incorporated, full validation is repeated, and the signed report is archived.
Registration data remains outside the publishable scope until a sufficient formal licence exists.
Every publishable record must include an identified source, extraction date, licence, owner, validation result, and relation to its previous version where applicable.
Transformed values must retain the source field.
Isolated manual corrections are not accepted.

The rerun starts from a clean copy, installs the exact ontology and shape versions, loads the manifest, transforms the records, executes the rules, and generates two outputs: a readable report and a structured file.
Checksums are compared before approval.
Manual review complements automated shapes and is applied to a stratified sample of procedures.
The sample contains records from every family, source system, and field status.
The reviewer compares the transformed value with the export, checks that the bilingual label preserves meaning, and verifies that every exception is justified.
Where a discrepancy cannot be resolved using available documentation, the record returns to pending status and municipal confirmation is requested.
The review uses a sheet containing the identifier, field, source value, transformed value, applied rule, outcome, and comment.
A second reviewer examines every critical error and at least ten percent of accepted records.
Disagreements are resolved in an adjudication session, and the decision is added to the rule catalogue.
This practice prevents a local correction from remaining isolated and allows the criterion to be reused in later loads.
Every figure in the executive summary is linked to the run that produced it.
The structured result file, shape version, batch manifest, and checksum are retained together.
PDF tables are generated from those results and are not edited manually.
Before signature, another person reproduces the main counts and compares a sample of identifiers with the readable report.
The report therefore serves as both technical evidence and a decision record.
evidence: The delivery file also contains municipal comments, decisions on false positives, the list of excluded fields, and evidence that registration data is not part of the publishable batch.
